title: Appending nil on the right is the identity for List.append
statement: For any list l, appending the empty list on the right leaves l unchanged.

formal.statement: theorem List.append_nil : ((x0 : Sort (1)) -> ((x1 : List.{0} x0) -> Eq.{1} (List.{0} x0) (List.append x0 x1 (List.nil.{0} x0)) x1))
